__comment: The climate (doc 34), read by RoomManager and its Climate component.
Height sets the year's mean: mean_at_reference_c at reference_y (the valley floor), one degree colder for every blocks_per_degree blocks up.
Open sky feels the whole swing: seasonal_swing_c through the year and daily_swing_c through the day, scaled and offset by the weather's own temperature block (data/weather).
Rock damps only the season: under n solid blocks a spot feels exp(-n / season_damping_blocks) of it. Day and night travel only through open air.
Outside air reaches outside_air_reach_blocks walking steps under a roof, fading on the way; doors stop it.

A sealed room adds heat units / max(volume, minimum_heated_volume), but its fires are tended: together they warm it to tended_fire_c before its doors leak, and no further (owner, 2026-10-30). The words: Frozen at frozen_at_c and below, Cold below cold_below_c, Chilly below comfortable_min_c, Comfortable to comfortable_max_c, then Hot.

Heat spreads (doc 34 'Heat and cold spreading'): a burning fire outside a sealed room warms the open air by heat units / open_air_heat_per_degree at the fire, at most open_air_fire_max_c, fading to nothing at its heat_source radius in walking steps; walls and doors stop it.

Each door pulls a sealed room door_leak of the way toward the temperature on its other side (another room or the open air beyond), times minimum_heated_volume / its volume for bigger rooms, over door_leak_passes passes.
